title: Death Takes a Halloween
plot_source_plaintext: On Halloween, Harry locks up a defendant known as the Spirit of Death (Stephen Root), whose imprisonment causes strange cases of people not dying. Meanwhile, Dan fears that he may die after seeing his obituary in the newspaper.
